description: Angular component for dashboard form management in Thingsboard UI, including form building, update, and interaction logic.

classes.name: DashboardFormComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending EntityComponent for creating and editing dashboards, with form controls and UI interactions.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component, sets dashboard scope and customer ID from table config, calls superclass init.

methods.name: isPublic
methods.description: Checks if a dashboard entity is public.

methods.name: isCurrentPublicCustomer
methods.description: Checks if a dashboard entity belongs to the current public customer.

methods.name: hideDelete
methods.description: Determines if delete option should be hidden based on config.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds reactive form for dashboard entity with validation.

methods.name: updateForm
methods.description: Updates form values with dashboard entity data.

methods.name: prepareFormValue
methods.description: Prepares form data for submission, merging configuration objects.

methods.name: onPublicLinkCopied
methods.description: Dispatches notification when public link is copied.

methods.name: onDashboardIdCopied
methods.description: Dispatches notification when dashboard ID is copied.

methods.name: updateFields
methods.description: Updates display fields like assigned customers text and public link based on entity.
